Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026: Your Gateway to a Valiant Career!

The moment of truth is here for thousands of aspiring Agniveers! The Indian Army has officially released the Admit Cards for the Common Entrance Examination (CEE) 2026. If you've applied to join the prestigious Indian Army through the Agniveer scheme, your essential hall ticket is now available for download on the official website. This blog post will guide you through everything you need to know about accessing your admit card, important dates, and preparing for the upcoming examination.

Key Dates and Details for Agniveer CEE 2026

The Indian Army Agniveer recruitment process for 2026 has been a significant event, drawing in a vast pool of determined candidates. Here’s a quick overview of the crucial dates that you need to be aware of:

Event Date
Online Application Start Date February 13, 2026
Online Application Last Date April 1, 2026 (or April 10, 2026 for some posts)
Admit Card Release Date May 15, 2026
CEE Exam Dates June 1, 2026 to June 15, 2026
Official Website joinindianarmy.nic.in

The Common Entrance Examination (CEE) for Indian Army Agniveer 2026 is being conducted from June 1, 2026, to June 15, 2026. Ensure you download your admit card well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical difficulties.

How to Download Your Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026

Downloading your admit card is a straightforward process. Follow these step-by-step instructions to ensure you secure your CEE Hall Ticket without any hassle:

1. Visit the Official Indian Army Website
Open your web browser and navigate to joinindianarmy.nic.in. This is the only official portal for downloading your admit card.
2. Locate the Agniveer Section
On the homepage, look for the 'Agnipath' section or a direct link for 'Agniveer CEE Admit Card 2026' or 'Download Hall Ticket'. You might need to click on 'Login/Apply Online' within the Agnipath tab.
3. Enter Your Login Credentials
You will be redirected to a login portal. Here, enter your Registration Number/Email ID and Password. You may also need to complete a captcha verification.
4. Access Your Dashboard and Download
After successful login, you will be taken to your Candidate Dashboard. Look for the 'CEE Admit Card 2026' link and click on it. Your admit card will then appear on the screen.
5. Print Your Admit Card
Download the PDF file and take a clear printout. It is highly recommended to print multiple copies in A4 size paper for future use and to bring to the examination centre.

What to Carry to the Examination Centre

To ensure a smooth experience on your exam day, make sure you have the following documents ready:

✅ Printed copy of your Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026 (A4 size).

✅ Valid Photo ID Proof (Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Driving License, Voter ID, Passport).

✅ Recent passport-size photographs.

✅ Any required stationery items as specified in the admit card instructions.

It is crucial to verify all the details printed on your admit card, including your name, roll number, photograph, and examination center details. In case of any discrepancies, immediately contact the concerned authorities of the Indian Army recruitment cell.

Understanding the Agniveer Selection Process

The Indian Army Agniveer selection process is a rigorous two-phase procedure designed to select the most suitable candidates. Familiarizing yourself with these phases can help you prepare comprehensively.

Phase 1: Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE)
This is the initial stage, where candidates undergo a computer-based online test. The CEE consists of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) covering subjects like General Knowledge, Maths, Science, and Reasoning. The duration and number of questions vary depending on the category of application.
Phase 2: Recruitment Rally
Candidates who qualify in the CEE proceed to the recruitment rally. This phase includes a Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Adaptability Test, and a Medical Examination. Successful completion of all these stages is mandatory for final selection.

Preparing for Success

With the exam dates from June 1 to June 15, 2026, time is of the essence. Focus on a structured study plan, revise key subjects, and practice with mock tests to enhance your speed and accuracy. Physical fitness is equally important, so maintain a regular exercise regimen to excel in Phase 2 of the selection process. The Indian Army is looking for young, dynamic, and dedicated individuals to serve the nation, and your preparation will reflect your commitment.

We wish all the Agniveer aspirants the very best for their upcoming examination!
